meta.title: fr-028 brüllwürfel
meta.author: farbrausch
meta.description: fr-028 brüllwürfel by farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from the release executable of fr-028 brüllwürfel, carved by v2redux at its own format version (`corpus/embedded/brullwurfel.v2m`). 120 BPM, 3:36, 11 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. Against the v2redux reference render it differs by +0.03 dB loudness and at most 0.14 @ 4000 Hz in any octave band (tools/unisynth-parity, A/B listening approved 2026-10-28).
